interpretation.delay_metric: Average completed-task total delay (s) = simulator reported accumulated network + queue waiting + CPU time.
interpretation.limitation: PureEdgeSim event-clock elapsed may differ from accumulated network delay because per-hop latency accounting and event scheduling do not use identical timing semantics. Do not interpret this value as wall-clock or pure network latency.
interpretation.workload_distribution: Simulator exposes dispatched task counts by destination layer (Cloud, Edge, Mist), but not per-node queue lengths or per-device utilization. Layer-level coefficient of variation is descriptive only and is not a node-level imbalance measure.
